title: The good and the not so good
body: EDIT - I am going to lower the rating until someone fixes this issue of asking me to rate the app every time I open it regardless of the fact I have already rated it and left a review. The app should be able to check the flag of whether the user - me - has already rated the app or not. This is basic. There are some interesting features about this app that make it a win. Like the per verse options to dig deeper into the meaning and make notes and favorite them as well as others. The swipe, which seems to be the theme of the app is interesting but I think it’s been taken too far. For example, if I want to read the chapter it confusingly still presents it as one verse at a time and I have to swipe for each verse. And more still are those verses that don’t fit in the small window in the middle of the screen so I have to swipe left to see the rest of the text. That is unnecessary because there is plenty of white space on the screen already to show the whole verse. Suggestions for the creator: - option to scroll the chapter rather than verse by verse. This is specifically about when I’m reading by chapter, not the random verses. - whole verse shown regardless of font size when there is room on the screen - a study more contextual option that opens up the chapter and gives more context around the whole setting and purpose for that writing. Maybe call it chapter study mode or something.

title: Great way to stay off of social media!

I knew I should read my Bible instead but just couldn’t bring myself to pick up the Book. The app offers you the ability to scroll each verse step by step, which allows you to take breaks and meditate on a verse without losing track of where you are at. Also, the deeper study and “explain it easier” parts of the app make for an additional immersive experience that is optional, which eliminates the pressure to deep-dive into everything and allows space for the Holy Spirit to “nudge” you in which verses to look into, and allows space to have potential questions answered about a text. I started in the book of John if anyone wants to join me!
